load_mcap_episodes: load episodes from MCAP files and auto-detect task metadata including image keys and action dimensions
detect_metadata_from_session: detect metadata from MCAP session topic including task ID, image keys, and proprioceptive keys
group_mcap_by_episode: group MCAP file paths by episode UUID and sort shards by shard number
parse_observation_from_example: parse observation dict and instruction string from a tf.train.Example protobuf message
parse_action_from_example: parse a flat action vector from a tf.train.Example protobuf message
